name: Parv Yadav
physicality: Excellent dribbling capability, mid-to-high natural endurance stamina. Currently working on explosive acceleration/speed mechanics. Main physical vulnerability is ball-shielding and handling aggressive physical contact from heavy defenders.
mentality: Projects a calm, composed exterior under high match pressure, but experiences intense internal nervousness. Plays with a composed, deliberate mindset, but prone to self-doubt, which occasionally limits aggressive playmaking.
recent_injuries_or_notes: No current injuries. Fully fit, ready for maximum training volume.
